WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_date,
        COUNT(order_items.product_id) AS sales_count
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)
),
regression AS (
    SELECT
        CAST((julianday(order_date) - julianday('2017-01-01')) AS INTEGER) AS day_number,
        sales_count
    FROM daily_sales
),
model AS (
    SELECT
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(day_number * sales_count) - SUM(day_number) * SUM(sales_count)) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*) * SUM(day_number * day_number) - SUM(day_number) * SUM(day_number)) AS slope,
        (SUM(sales_count) -
         ((COUNT(*) * SUM(day_number * sales_count) - SUM(day_number) * SUM(sales_count)) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*) * SUM(day_number * day_number) - SUM(day_number) * SUM(day_number))) * SUM(day_number)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS intercept
    FROM regression
),
predicted_sales AS (
    SELECT
        date('2018-12-05', '+' || offset || ' days') AS order_date,
        slope * (julianday(date('2018-12-05', '+' || offset || ' days')) - julianday('2017-01-01')) + intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM model, (SELECT 0 AS offset UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS offsets
),
five_day_sma AS (
    SELECT
        p1.order_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS sma_5day
    FROM predicted_sales p1
    JOIN predicted_sales p2 ON julianday(p2.order_date) BETWEEN julianday(p1.order_date, '-2 days') AND julianday(p1.order_date, '+2 days')
    GROUP BY p1.order_date
)
SELECT SUM(sma_5day) AS sum_of_smas
FROM five_day_sma
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08';

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_recency AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase_date
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_order_date FROM delivered_orders
),
customer_r AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_unique_id,
        julianday(m.max_order_date) - julianday(r.last_purchase_date) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_recency r, max_date m
),
customer_f AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS frequency
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
customer_m AS (
    SELECT o.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_unique_id
),
quantiles AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS R_score,
        frequency,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS F_score,
        monetary,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS M_score
    FROM (
        SELECT r.customer_unique_id, r.recency_days, f.frequency, m.monetary
        FROM customer_r r
        JOIN customer_f f ON r.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
        JOIN customer_m m ON r.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
    ) sub
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        R_score AS R,
        F_score AS F,
        M_score AS M,
        CAST(R_score AS TEXT) || CAST(F_score AS TEXT) || CAST(M_score AS TEXT) AS RFM_score,
        (F_score + M_score) AS FM_sum,
        CASE
            WHEN R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN R_score IN (4, 5) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN R_score IN (4, 5) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN R_score IN (4, 5) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN R_score IN (2, 3) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN R_score = 3 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (R_score = 2 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN R_score = 2 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN R_score = 3 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END AS segment
    FROM quantiles
),
customer_order_summary AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_spend
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
rfm_avg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.segment,
        AVG(co.total_spend / co.total_orders) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM rfm_segments s
    JOIN customer_order_summary co ON s.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
    GROUP BY s.segment
)

SELECT * FROM rfm_avg_sales
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC;

WITH CustomerOrderStats AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders,
    AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase,
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
CustomerLifespan AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    num_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE
      WHEN (JULIANDAY(last_purchase) - JULIANDAY(first_purchase)) / 7.0 < 1 THEN 1.0
      ELSE (JULIANDAY(last_purchase) - JULIANDAY(first_purchase)) / 7.0
    END AS lifespan_weeks
  FROM CustomerOrderStats
)
SELECT customer_id, num_orders, avg_payment_per_order, lifespan_weeks
FROM CustomerLifespan
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH player_career_span AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(strftime('%Y', final_game) - strftime('%Y', debut)), 2) AS years_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(strftime('%m', final_game) - strftime('%m', debut)), 2) AS months_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(strftime('%d', final_game) - strftime('%d', debut)), 2) AS days_diff
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
), career_span_calculated AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    years_diff + (months_diff / 12.0) + (days_diff / 365.0) AS career_span
  FROM player_career_span
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) AS avg_career_span_years
FROM career_span_calculated;

WITH MaxStats AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(g) AS MaxGames,
        MAX(r) AS MaxRuns,
        MAX(h) AS MaxHits,
        MAX(hr) AS MaxHomeRuns
    FROM batting
),
MaxPlayers AS (
    SELECT player_id, g, r, h, hr FROM batting WHERE g = (SELECT MaxGames FROM MaxStats)
    UNION
    SELECT player_id, g, r, h, hr FROM batting WHERE r = (SELECT MaxRuns FROM MaxStats)
    UNION
    SELECT player_id, g, r, h, hr FROM batting WHERE h = (SELECT MaxHits FROM MaxStats)
    UNION
    SELECT player_id, g, r, h, hr FROM batting WHERE hr = (SELECT MaxHomeRuns FROM MaxStats)
)
SELECT p.name_given, mp.g, mp.r, mp.h, mp.hr
FROM MaxPlayers mp
JOIN player p ON mp.player_id = p.player_id;

WITH city_coords AS (
    SELECT airport_code, city, 
        CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS TEXT), 1, 3) AS FLOAT) AS longitude,
        CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS TEXT), 4, 3) AS FLOAT) AS latitude
    FROM airports_data
), city_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN dep.city < arr.city THEN dep.city ELSE arr.city END AS city1,
        CASE WHEN dep.city < arr.city THEN arr.city ELSE dep.city END AS city2,
        AVG(
            2 * 6371 * ASIN(
                SQRT(
                    POWER(SIN((RADIANS(arr.latitude) - RADIANS(dep.latitude)) / 2), 2) +
                    COS(RADIANS(dep.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(arr.latitude)) * POWER(SIN((RADIANS(arr.longitude) - RADIANS(dep.longitude)) / 2), 2)
                )
            )
        ) AS avg_distance
    FROM flights f
    JOIN city_coords dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN city_coords arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
    GROUP BY city1, city2
), buckets AS (
    SELECT city1, city2, avg_distance,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN 0
        WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN 1000
        WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN 2000
        WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN 3000
        WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN 4000
        WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN 5000
        ELSE 6000
    END AS distance_range
    FROM city_pairs
), bucket_counts AS (
    SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM buckets
    GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT pair_count
FROM bucket_counts
WHERE pair_count = (
    SELECT MIN(pair_count) FROM bucket_counts
)
LIMIT 1000
;

WITH motorcycle_helmet AS (
  SELECT
    p.case_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helmet_used
  FROM parties p
  WHERE p.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle'
  GROUP BY p.case_id
), collisions_motorcycle_fatalities AS (
  SELECT
    c.case_id,
    c.motorcyclist_killed_count
  FROM collisions c
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
)
SELECT
  mh.helmet_used,
  COUNT(cmf.case_id) AS total_collisions,
  SUM(cmf.motorcyclist_killed_count) AS total_fatalities,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(cmf.motorcyclist_killed_count) AS FLOAT)/COUNT(cmf.case_id)*100, 2) AS fatality_rate_percentage
FROM collisions_motorcycle_fatalities cmf
JOIN motorcycle_helmet mh ON cmf.case_id = mh.case_id
GROUP BY mh.helmet_used
ORDER BY mh.helmet_used DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH YearCauseCounts AS (
  SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
         primary_collision_factor AS cause,
         COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, cause
), RankedCauses AS (
  SELECT year, cause, count,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count DESC) AS rank
  FROM YearCauseCounts
), TopTwoCauses AS (
  SELECT year, cause
  FROM RankedCauses
  WHERE rank <= 2
), YearCausePairs AS (
  SELECT year, GROUP_CONCAT(cause, ',') AS causes
  FROM TopTwoCauses
  GROUP BY year
), CommonCauses AS (
  SELECT causes
  FROM YearCausePairs
  GROUP BY causes
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT year
FROM YearCausePairs
WHERE causes NOT IN (SELECT causes FROM CommonCauses)
LIMIT 1;

WITH factor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', collisions.collision_date) AS year,
        collisions.pcf_violation_category AS violation_category,
        COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM collisions
    WHERE year IN ('2011', '2021')
    GROUP BY year, violation_category
),

factor_totals AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        SUM(count) AS total_count
    FROM factor_counts
    GROUP BY year
),

ranked_factors_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        violation_category,
        count
    FROM factor_counts
    WHERE year = '2021'
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

shares AS (
    SELECT
        f.year,
        f.violation_category,
        f.count * 1.0 / t.total_count * 100 AS share
    FROM factor_counts f
    JOIN factor_totals t
    ON f.year = t.year
    WHERE f.violation_category = (SELECT violation_category FROM ranked_factors_2021)
)

SELECT
    (SELECT share FROM shares WHERE year = '2011') - (SELECT share FROM shares WHERE year = '2021') AS share_decrease_percentage_points
;

WITH NXT_Title_Matches AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.duration, m.title_change
  FROM Matches m
  JOIN Match_Types mt ON m.match_type_id = mt.id
  WHERE mt.name LIKE '%NXT%'
    AND m.title_change = 0
    AND m.title_id IS NOT NULL
),
Parsed_Duration AS (
  SELECT id, CAST(substr(duration, 1, instr(duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
             CAST(substr(duration, instr(duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS duration_seconds
  FROM NXT_Title_Matches
),
Shortest_Match AS (
  SELECT id, MIN(duration_seconds) AS min_duration
  FROM Parsed_Duration
  GROUP BY id
  ORDER BY min_duration ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
Match_Wrestlers AS (
  SELECT id, winner_id, loser_id
  FROM Matches
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM Shortest_Match)
),
Wrestler_Names AS (
  SELECT w.name, w.id
  FROM Wrestlers w
  WHERE w.id IN (SELECT winner_id FROM Match_Wrestlers UNION SELECT loser_id FROM Match_Wrestlers)
)
SELECT group_concat(name, ', ') AS wrestlers
FROM Wrestler_Names
LIMIT 1000

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ball_by_ball.bowler AS bowler_id,
    COUNT(*) AS wickets,
    SUM(ball_by_ball.runs_off_bat + ball_by_ball.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded
  FROM wicket_taken
  JOIN ball_by_ball ON wicket_taken.match_id = ball_by_ball.match_id
    AND wicket_taken.over_id = ball_by_ball.over_id
    AND wicket_taken.ball_id = ball_by_ball.ball_id
    AND wicket_taken.innings_no = ball_by_ball.innings_no
  GROUP BY ball_by_ball.bowler
)
SELECT player.player_name, (runs_conceded * 1.0 / wickets) AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_stats
JOIN player ON player.player_id = bowler_stats.bowler_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH striker_runs AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id,
           pm.match_id,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id
    WHERE pm.role = 'batsman'
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.match_id
    HAVING total_runs > 50
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS avg_total_runs
FROM striker_runs;

WITH match_loser AS (
  SELECT match_id, 
         CASE WHEN team_1 = match_winner THEN team_2 ELSE team_1 END AS loser_team
  FROM match
),
players_runs AS (
  SELECT bb.striker AS player_id, bs.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.striker, bs.match_id
  HAVING total_runs >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM players_runs pr
JOIN player_match pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id AND pr.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN match_loser ml ON pr.match_id = ml.match_id AND pm.team_id = ml.loser_team
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pr.player_id;

WITH player_match_runs AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    pm.match_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM player_match pm
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id
  WHERE bs.innings_no = 1
  GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.match_id
),
player_avg_runs AS (
  SELECT
    pmr.player_id,
    AVG(pmr.total_runs) AS avg_runs_per_match
  FROM player_match_runs pmr
  JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season_id = 5
  GROUP BY pmr.player_id
),
player_season_runs AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM player_match pm
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id
  JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season_id = 5 AND bs.innings_no = 1
  GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_total_outs AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
  FROM player_match pm
  JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season_id = 5
  GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_batting_average AS (
  SELECT
    psr.player_id,
    CAST(psr.total_runs AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(p_to.matches_played, 0) AS batting_average
  FROM player_season_runs psr
  JOIN player_total_outs p_to ON psr.player_id = p_to.player_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_name,
  par.avg_runs_per_match,
  pba.batting_average
FROM player_avg_runs par
JOIN player p ON par.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_batting_average pba ON par.player_id = pba.player_id
ORDER BY par.avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH OverRuns AS (
    SELECT
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS batsman_runs,
        COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) AS extra_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.over_id
),
MaxOverRuns AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        over_id,
        (batsman_runs + extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT
            match_id,
            innings_no,
            over_id,
            batsman_runs,
            extra_runs,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY (batsman_runs + extra_runs) DESC) AS rn
        FROM OverRuns
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
MaxOverWithBowler AS (
    SELECT
        mor.match_id,
        mor.innings_no,
        mor.over_id,
        mor.total_runs,
        bb.bowler
    FROM MaxOverRuns mor
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
        ON bb.match_id = mor.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = mor.innings_no 
        AND bb.over_id = mor.over_id
    GROUP BY mor.match_id, mor.innings_no, mor.over_id, mor.total_runs, bb.bowler
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_runs) AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM
    MaxOverWithBowler;

WITH ball_runs AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, bowler, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_over
  FROM ball_by_ball
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, bowler
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(runs_in_over) AS max_runs_in_match
  FROM ball_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_per_match AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.bowler, b.runs_in_over
  FROM ball_runs b
  JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id AND b.runs_in_over = m.max_runs_in_match
),
top_bowlers AS (
  SELECT match_id, bowler, runs_in_over
  FROM max_over_per_match
  ORDER BY runs_in_over DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT tb.bowler, tb.match_id, tb.runs_in_over
FROM top_bowlers tb
ORDER BY tb.runs_in_over DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2016' THEN 1 END) AS "2016",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' THEN 1 END) AS "2017",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' THEN 1 END) AS "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH DeliveredOrders AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, o.order_id
  FROM olist_orders o
  JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
OrderCounts AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(order_id) AS delivered_order_count
  FROM DeliveredOrders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
  ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
CustomerPayments AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
  FROM olist_orders o
  JOIN olist_order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
CustomerLocation AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, customer_city, customer_state
  FROM olist_customers
)
SELECT 
  oc.customer_unique_id,
  oc.delivered_order_count,
  cp.avg_payment_value,
  cl.customer_city,
  cl.customer_state
FROM OrderCounts oc
JOIN CustomerPayments cp ON oc.customer_unique_id = cp.customer_unique_id
JOIN CustomerLocation cl ON oc.customer_unique_id = cl.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY oc.delivered_order_count DESC;

WITH city_payments_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_city,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM olist_customers c
    JOIN olist_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_city
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_payments) AS avg_total_payments,
    AVG(delivered_order_count) AS avg_delivered_order_count
FROM (
    SELECT total_payments, delivered_order_count
    FROM city_payments_orders
    ORDER BY total_payments ASC
    LIMIT 5
);

WITH yearly_delivered AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', order_approved_at) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND strftime('%Y', order_approved_at) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
  GROUP BY year
),
lowest_year AS (
  SELECT year
  FROM yearly_delivered
  ORDER BY delivered_orders ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_delivered AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', order_approved_at) AS year,
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_approved_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders_month
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT MAX(delivered_orders_month) AS highest_monthly_delivered_orders
FROM monthly_delivered
WHERE year = (SELECT year FROM lowest_year);

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, oi.seller_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_distinct_customers AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_customers
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
order_profits AS (
    SELECT seller_id, SUM(price - freight_value) AS profit
    FROM olist_order_items oi

    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip
  FROM olist_geolocation
), distances AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    prev_zip,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    prev_lat,
    prev_lng,
    6371 * acos(
      cos(radians(prev_lat)) * cos(radians(geolocation_lat)) * cos(radians(geolocation_lng) - radians(prev_lng)) +
      sin(radians(prev_lat)) * sin(radians(geolocation_lat))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ordered_cities
  WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL
)

  WHERE s.promo_id = 0
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('Q4 2019', 'Q4 2020')
),

city_q4_sales AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    calendar_quarter_desc AS quarter,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM us_sales_q4
  GROUP BY city, quarter
),

-- Filter cities where sales rose at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020
cities_increase_20 AS (
  SELECT
    city
  FROM city_q4_sales
  GROUP BY city
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q4 2020' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) >=
    1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q4 2019' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END)
),

-- Calculate sales by product in these cities across the two quarters
product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    calendar_quarter_desc AS quarter,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS sales
  FROM us_sales_q4
  WHERE city IN (SELECT city FROM cities_increase_20)
  GROUP BY prod_id, quarter
),

-- Overall sales by product across quarters
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),

-- Rank products by total sales and keep top 20%
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    total_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS quintile
  FROM product_total_sales
),

top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE quintile = 1
),

-- Total sales in the cities by quarter
total_sales_q4 AS (
  SELECT
    quarter,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM product_sales
  GROUP BY quarter
),

-- Sales of top products by quarter
 top_product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    quarter,
    sales
  FROM product_sales
  WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
),

-- Calculate share and share change from 2019 to 2020
share_changes AS (
  SELECT
    tps.prod_id,
    COALESCE(tps_2019.sales, 0) AS sales_2019,
    COALESCE(tps_2020.sales, 0) AS sales_2020,
    ts_2019.total_sales AS total_2019,
    ts_2020.total_sales AS total_2020,
    CASE WHEN ts_2019.total_sales > 0 THEN tps_2019.sales / ts_2019.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS share_2019,
    CASE WHEN ts_2020.total_sales > 0 THEN tps_2020.sales / ts_2020.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS share_2020,
    CASE WHEN ts_2019.total_sales > 0 AND ts_2020.total_sales > 0 THEN
      (tps_2020.sales / ts_2020.total_sales) - (tps_2019.sales / ts_2019.total_sales)
      ELSE 0 END AS share_change
  FROM top_product_sales tps
  LEFT JOIN product_sales tps_2019 ON tps.prod_id = tps_2019.prod_id AND tps_2019.quarter = 'Q4 2019'
  LEFT JOIN product_sales tps_2020 ON tps.prod_id = tps_2020.prod_id AND tps_2020.quarter = 'Q4 2020'
  LEFT JOIN total_sales_q4 ts_2019 ON ts_2019.quarter = 'Q4 2019'
  LEFT JOIN total_sales_q4 ts_2020 ON ts_2020.quarter = 'Q4 2020'
  GROUP BY tps.prod_id, tps_2019.sales, tps_2020.sales, ts_2019.total_sales, ts_2020.total_sales
)

  prod_id AS product_id,
  share_2019,
  share_2020,
  share_change
FROM share_changes
ORDER BY share_change DESC
LIMIT 1000;

-- Pivot the sales to get 2019 and 2020 side by side
sales_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,

    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN sales_amount END), 0) AS sales_2020
  FROM monthly_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, month

-- Calculate projected sales for 2021 using the formula:
-- (((Sales in 2020 - Sales in 2019) / Sales in 2019) * Sales in 2020) + Sales in 2020
projected_sales_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,
    CASE
      WHEN sales_2019 = 0 THEN sales_2020
      ELSE (((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * sales_2020) / sales_2019) + sales_2020
    END AS projected_sales_amount
  FROM sales_pivot
),

  FROM projected_sales_2021 p
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates_2021 er ON er.month = p.month
  GROUP BY p.month

SalesWithCosts AS (

CustomerProfits AS (

ProfitStats AS (

),
Buckets AS (
  SELECT

    CASE

    END AS bucket
  FROM CustomerProfits, ProfitStats
)

city_sales_2019 AS (

city_sales_2020 AS (

city_growth AS (

filtered_sales_2019 AS (

all_products AS (

  SELECT prod_id FROM filtered_sales_2020

total_sales_combined AS (
  SELECT
    p.prod_id,
    COALESCE(f19.sales_2019, 0) AS sales_2019,
    COALESCE(f20.sales_2020, 0) AS sales_2020,
    COALESCE(f19.sales_2019, 0) + COALESCE(f20.sales_2020, 0) AS total_sales
  FROM all_products p
  LEFT JOIN filtered_sales_2019 f19 ON p.prod_id = f19.prod_id
  LEFT JOIN filtered_sales_2020 f20 ON p.prod_id = f20.prod_id
),

),

product_shares AS (
  SELECT
    t.prod_id,

    t.sales_2020,
    (t.sales_2019 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2019 AS share_2019,
    (t.sales_2020 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2020 AS share_2020,
    100.0 * ((t.sales_2020 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2020 - (t.sales_2019 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2019) AS pct_point_change,
    t.total_sales
  FROM total_sales_combined t, total_2019_2020 tot
),

percentile_80_threshold AS (

WITH monthly_balances AS (

  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),
monthly_positive_counts AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS positive_customer_count
  FROM monthly_balances
  WHERE month_end_balance > 0
  GROUP BY year_month
),
max_min_counts AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(positive_customer_count) AS max_count,
    MIN(positive_customer_count) AS min_count
  FROM monthly_positive_counts
),
max_month AS (
  SELECT year_month FROM monthly_positive_counts, max_min_counts
  WHERE positive_customer_count = max_count
  LIMIT 1
),
min_month AS (
  SELECT year_month FROM monthly_positive_counts, max_min_counts
  WHERE positive_customer_count = min_count
  LIMIT 1
),
avg_balances AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
  WHERE year_month IN (SELECT year_month FROM max_month UNION SELECT year_month FROM min_month)
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  (SELECT year_month FROM max_month) AS max_positive_month,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM max_month)) AS avg_balance_max_month,
  (SELECT year_month FROM min_month) AS min_positive_month,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM min_month)) AS avg_balance_min_month,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM max_month)) -

groups AS (
  SELECT city_name, MIN(date) AS start_date, MAX(date) AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS length

min_max_lengths AS (

  FROM groups

shortest_streaks AS (

  FROM groups g
  JOIN min_max_lengths mml ON g.length = mml.min_length

longest_streaks AS (

formatted_shortest AS (

WITH monthly_interest_composition AS (
  SELECT
    month_year AS month,
    interest_id,
    AVG(composition / index_value) AS avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE month_year BETWEEN '2018-09' AND '2019-08'
  GROUP BY month, interest_id
),
monthly_max_interest AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    interest_id AS max_interest,
    avg_composition AS max_index_composition
  FROM (
    SELECT
      month,
      interest_id,
      avg_composition,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rnk
    FROM monthly_interest_composition
  )
  WHERE rnk = 1
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    a.month,
    a.max_interest,
    a.max_index_composition,
    LAG(a.max_interest,1) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev1_interest,
    LAG(a.max_index_composition,1) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev1_max,
    LAG(a.max_interest,2) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev2_interest,
    LAG(a.max_index_composition,2) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev2_max
  FROM monthly_max_interest a
),
rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    max_interest,
    max_index_composition,
    prev1_interest,
    prev1_max,
    prev2_interest,
    prev2_max,
    AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_3m
  FROM with_lag
)
SELECT * FROM rolling_avg
ORDER BY month;

GroupCounts AS (

MaxSalesByRegion AS (

),
Ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        StudLastName,
        Grade,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Completed_English c2 WHERE c2.Grade >= c1.Grade) AS RankDesc,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Completed_English) AS TotalCount
    FROM Completed_English c1
)
SELECT 
    StudLastName,
    Grade,
    CASE 
        WHEN RankDesc <= TotalCount * 0.2 THEN 'First'
        WHEN RankDesc <= TotalCount * 0.4 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN RankDesc <= TotalCount * 0.6 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN RankDesc <= TotalCount * 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
FROM Ranking
ORDER BY

        WHEN 'First' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Second' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Third' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5

WITH yearly_purchases AS (

    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bp.ticker = bt.ticker AND bp.market_date = bt.txn_date
    GROUP BY year, bm.region
),
ranked_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        region,
        total_spent / total_quantity AS avg_purchase_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY (total_spent / total_quantity) DESC) AS rank
    FROM yearly_purchases
    WHERE year NOT IN (
        SELECT MIN(year) FROM yearly_purchases yp2 WHERE yp2.region = yearly_purchases.region
    )
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        rp.year,
        rp.region,
        rp.avg_purchase_price,
        rp.rank,
        (rp.avg_purchase_price - LAG(rp.avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY rp.region ORDER BY rp.year))
        / LAG(rp.avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY rp.region ORDER BY rp.year) * 100 AS pct_change
    FROM ranked_purchases rp
)
SELECT * 
FROM percentage_change
ORDER BY year, rank, region;

WITH converted_volume AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    market_date AS date,
    CASE
      WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000000
      WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000
      WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(volume AS FLOAT)
    END AS volume_num
  FROM bitcoin_prices
  WHERE market_date BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
prev_nonzero_volume AS (
  SELECT
    a.ticker,
    a.date,
    a.volume_num,
    (
      SELECT volume_num
      FROM converted_volume b
      WHERE b.ticker = a.ticker
        AND b.date < a.date
        AND b.volume_num > 0
      ORDER BY b.date DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS prev_vol
  FROM converted_volume a
),
daily_pct_change AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    date,
    volume_num,
    prev_vol,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_vol IS NOT NULL AND prev_vol > 0 THEN ((volume_num - prev_vol) / prev_vol) * 100
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pct_change
  FROM prev_nonzero_volume
)
SELECT ticker, date, pct_change
FROM daily_pct_change
ORDER BY ticker, date;

WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT
        id_bioguide,
        MIN(term_start) AS first_start_date
    FROM
        legislators_terms
    WHERE
        term_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        id_bioguide
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        id_bioguide,
        first_start_date
    FROM
        first_terms
),
retention_years AS (
    SELECT
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.first_start_date,
        y.year_num,
        DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', c.first_start_date) || '-12-31', '+' || y.year_num || ' years') AS retention_date
    FROM
        cohort c,
        (SELECT 1 AS year_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL
         SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL
         SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL
         SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20) y
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT
        ry.year_num,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ry.id_bioguide) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ry.id_bioguide
              AND lt.term_start <= ry.retention_date
              AND (lt.term_end IS NULL OR lt.term_end >= ry.retention_date)
        ) THEN ry.id_bioguide END) AS retained_count
    FROM
        retention_years ry
    GROUP BY
        ry.year_num
)
SELECT
    year_num,
    CAST(retained_count AS FLOAT) / cohort_size AS retention_rate
FROM
    retention_check
ORDER BY
    year_num;

WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT 
    l.id_bioguide,
    l.gender,
    lt.state,
    MIN(date(lt.term_start)) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state
),
retained_at_years AS (
  SELECT
    ft.state,
    ft.gender,
    ft.id_bioguide,
    yr.yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
       WHEN date(ft.first_term_start, '+' || yr.yr || ' years') BETWEEN date(lt.term_start) AND date(lt.term_end)
       THEN 1 END) AS retained
  FROM first_term ft
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES (0),(2),(4),(6),(8),(10)) AS yr(yr)
  GROUP BY ft.state, ft.gender, ft.id_bioguide, yr.yr
),
state_gender_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    gender,
    yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS retained_legislators,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) FROM first_term WHERE state = r.state AND gender = r.gender) AS total_legislators
  FROM retained_at_years r
  WHERE retained > 0
  GROUP BY state, gender, yr
),
state_gender_valid AS (

valid_states AS (

WITH louisiana_male_legislators AS (

years_range AS (

  SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL

  SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL
  SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL

active_per_year AS (

active_on_dec31 AS (

WITH customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT
        r.customer_id,
        MIN(r.rental_date) AS first_rental,
        SUM(p.amount) AS lifetime_sales
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY r.customer_id
),
customer_sales_in_period AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.lifetime_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= DATETIME(c.first_rental, '+7 days') THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_7d,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= DATETIME(c.first_rental, '+30 days') THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_30d
    FROM customer_ltv c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.lifetime_sales
)
SELECT
    AVG(sales_7d * 1.0 / lifetime_sales) AS avg_pct_sales_first_7_days,
    AVG(sales_30d * 1.0 / lifetime_sales) AS avg_pct_sales_first_30_days,
    AVG(lifetime_sales) AS avg_lifetime_sales
FROM customer_sales_in_period
WHERE lifetime_sales > 0;

  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id

),
Actor_Film_Count AS (

),
Actor_Film_Revenue AS (

),
Top3_Revenue_Films AS (

    total_revenue,

),
Avg_Revenue_Per_Actor AS (

SELECT

  t3.title,

FROM Top3_Revenue_Films t3
JOIN Avg_Revenue_Per_Actor ar ON t3.actor_id = ar.actor_id

WHERE t3.rn <= 3
ORDER BY t3.actor_id, t3.total_revenue DESC;

WITH TopActors AS (

CustomersWhoRentedTopActorFilms AS (

TotalCustomers AS (

WITH FirstRental AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_payment_date
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
FirstRentalDetail AS (
    SELECT
        fr.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM FirstRental fr
    JOIN payment p ON fr.customer_id = p.customer_id AND fr.first_payment_date = p.payment_date
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
CustomerSummaries AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(r.rental_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM customer c
    JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    frd.rating,
    AVG(cs.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM FirstRentalDetail frd
JOIN CustomerSummaries cs ON frd.customer_id = cs.customer_id
GROUP BY frd.rating
ORDER BY frd.rating;

WITH TopCustomers AS (

    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
MonthlyPayments AS (
    SELECT

    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM TopCustomers)
    GROUP BY customer_id, payment_month
),
MonthlyDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        a.customer_id,
        a.payment_month,
        ROUND(ABS(a.total_amount - IFNULL(b.total_amount, 0)), 2) AS diff
    FROM MonthlyPayments a
    LEFT JOIN MonthlyPayments b ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id 
        AND b.payment_month = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE(a.payment_month || '-01', '+1 month'))
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month AS month_of_change,
    diff AS max_monthly_difference
FROM MonthlyDifference
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CountryCustomerCounts AS (

CountrySales AS (

MedianCalc AS (

max_rentals AS (

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT
    words AS word,
    LENGTH(words) AS len,
    SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) AS first_char,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ch, '')
     FROM (SELECT SUBSTR(words, i, 1) AS ch
           FROM (SELECT 1 AS i UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5) idx
           WHERE i <= LENGTH(words)
           ORDER BY SUBSTR(words, i, 1))
    ) AS signature
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
), grouped AS (
  SELECT signature, COUNT(*) AS anagram_count
  FROM cte
  GROUP BY signature
  HAVING anagram_count > 1
)
SELECT word, anagram_count
FROM cte
JOIN grouped USING (signature)
ORDER BY word
LIMIT 10;

WITH Top10States AS (

StateStats AS (

delivered_orders AS (

WITH monthly_orders AS (

        COUNT(orders.order_id) AS finished_orders
    FROM orders
    JOIN hubs ON orders.order_id = orders.order_id
    WHERE orders.order_status = 'finished'

    GROUP BY hubs.hub_id, orders.order_created_year, orders.order_created_month
),
feb_mar_orders AS (
    SELECT
        hub_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN order_created_month = 2 THEN finished_orders ELSE 0 END) AS feb_orders,

    FROM monthly_orders
    GROUP BY hub_id
)
SELECT hub_id
FROM feb_mar_orders
WHERE feb_orders > 0
  AND (mar_orders - feb_orders) * 1.0 / feb_orders > 0.2;

  JOIN Team T ON T.team_api_id IN (M.home_team_api_id, M.away_team_api_id)

Ranked_Wins AS (

WITH PlayerMatchParticipation AS (
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id, home_team_api_id AS team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_2, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_3, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_4, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_4 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_5, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_5 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_6, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_6 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_7, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_7 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_8, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_8 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_9, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_9 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_10, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_10 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, home_player_11, home_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_11 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_1, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_2, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_3, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_3 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_4, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_4 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_5, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_5 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_6, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_6 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_7, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_7 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_8, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_8 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_9, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_9 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_10, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_10 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, away_player_11, away_team_api_id FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
),
PlayerMatchResult AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id,
        p.match_api_id,
        CASE
            WHEN m.home_team_api_id = p.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN m.away_team_api_id = p.team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN m.home_team_api_id = p.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 'lose'
            WHEN m.away_team_api_id = p.team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal < m.home_team_goal THEN 'lose'
            ELSE 'draw'
        END AS match_result
    FROM PlayerMatchParticipation p
    JOIN Match m ON m.match_api_id = p.match_api_id
    WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
),
PlayerWinCounts AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM PlayerMatchResult
    WHERE match_result = 'win'
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
PlayerLoseCounts AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS lose_count
    FROM PlayerMatchResult
    WHERE match_result = 'lose'
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
MaxWin AS (
    SELECT MAX(win_count) AS max_win FROM PlayerWinCounts
),
MaxLose AS (
    SELECT MAX(lose_count) AS max_lose FROM PlayerLoseCounts
)
SELECT
    (SELECT player_api_id FROM PlayerWinCounts WHERE win_count = (SELECT max_win FROM MaxWin) LIMIT 1) AS player_with_most_wins,
    (SELECT player_api_id FROM PlayerLoseCounts WHERE lose_count = (SELECT max_lose FROM MaxLose) LIMIT 1) AS player_with_most_losses;

WITH season_runs AS (

        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs

    AND pm.role = 'batsman' -- considering only players in batsman role

    GROUP BY m.season_id, pm.player_id
),
season_wickets AS (
    SELECT
        m.season_id,
        wt.player_out AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, wt.player_out
),
ranked_batsmen AS (
    SELECT
        season_id,
        player_id,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM season_runs
),
ranked_bowlers AS (
    SELECT
        season_id,
        player_id,
        total_wickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM season_wickets
),
batsmen_top3 AS (

        season_id,
        player_id,
        total_runs,

),
bowlers_top3 AS (
    SELECT

        player_id,
        total_wickets,
        rn
    FROM ranked_bowlers
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT
    b.season_id,
    b.player_id AS batsman_id,
    b.total_runs,
    bow.player_id AS bowler_id,
    bow.total_wickets
FROM batsmen_top3 b
JOIN bowlers_top3 bow ON b.season_id = bow.season_id AND b.rn = bow.rn
ORDER BY b.season_id, b.rn;

WITH partnership_runs AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        team_batting,
        striker AS player1_id,
        non_striker AS player2_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(batsman_runs, 0) + COALESCE(extra_runs, 0)) AS total_partnership_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = player1_id THEN COALESCE(batsman_runs, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS player1_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = player2_id THEN COALESCE(batsman_runs, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS player2_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.team_batting, b.striker, b.non_striker,
            COALESCE(br.runs_scored, 0) AS batsman_runs,
            COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS extra_runs
        FROM ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored br
            ON b.match_id = br.match_id AND b.ball_id = br.ball_id AND b.innings_no = br.innings_no
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
            ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    ) subquery
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, team_batting, player1_id, player2_id
),
ranked_partnerships AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_partnership_runs DESC) AS rnk
    FROM partnership_runs
    WHERE player1_id IS NOT NULL AND player2_id IS NOT NULL
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        CASE
            WHEN player1_runs > player2_runs THEN player1_id
            WHEN player1_runs < player2_runs THEN player2_id
            ELSE CASE WHEN player1_id > player2_id THEN player1_id ELSE player2_id END
        END AS player1_id,
        CASE
            WHEN player1_runs > player2_runs THEN player2_id
            WHEN player1_runs < player2_runs THEN player1_id
            ELSE CASE WHEN player1_id > player2_id THEN player2_id ELSE player1_id END
        END AS player2_id,
        CASE
            WHEN player1_runs > player2_runs THEN player1_runs
            WHEN player1_runs < player2_runs THEN player2_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN player1_id > player2_id THEN player1_runs ELSE player2_runs END
        END AS player1_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN player1_runs > player2_runs THEN player2_runs
            WHEN player1_runs < player2_runs THEN player1_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN player1_id > player2_id THEN player2_runs ELSE player1_runs END
        END AS player2_runs,
        total_partnership_runs
    FROM ranked_partnerships
    WHERE rnk = 1
)
SELECT match_id, player1_id, player2_id, player1_runs, player2_runs, total_partnership_runs
FROM final_result
ORDER BY match_id, player1_id, player2_id
LIMIT 1000;

DirectorsInTopGenres AS (

DirectorCounts AS (

WITH TrackDurations AS (

Stats AS (

),
Categories AS (
  SELECT
    t.TrackId,

    CASE
      WHEN t.DurationMinutes <= (s.MinDuration + s.AvgDuration) / 2 THEN 'Short'

      ELSE 'Long'

RevenueByCategory AS (
  SELECT

    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue

)

WITH BowlerWickets AS (
    SELECT
        w.player_out AS bowler_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    WHERE w.player_out IS NOT NULL
      AND w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
    GROUP BY w.player_out
),

BallsBowled AS (
    SELECT
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    WHERE e.extra_type IS NULL OR e.extra_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no-ball')
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),

RunsConceded AS (
    SELECT
        b.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    WHERE e.extra_type IS NULL OR e.extra_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no-ball')
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),

FilteredBalls AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.bowler,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.innings_no,
        CASE WHEN e.extra_type IS NULL OR e.extra_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no-ball') THEN bs.runs_scored ELSE 0 END AS runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),

MatchBowlerPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        fb.bowler,
        fb.match_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wt.kind_out IS NOT NULL AND wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS wickets,
        SUM(fb.runs_off_bat) AS runs_conceded
    FROM FilteredBalls fb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON fb.match_id = wt.match_id AND fb.over_id = wt.over_id AND fb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND fb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    GROUP BY fb.bowler, fb.match_id
),

BestPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        mbp.bowler,
        mbp.match_id,
        mbp.wickets,
        mbp.runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mbp.bowler ORDER BY mbp.wickets DESC, mbp.runs_conceded ASC) AS rn
    FROM MatchBowlerPerformance mbp
)

SELECT
    bw.bowler_id,
    bw.total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN bb.balls_bowled = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(rc.runs_conceded AS FLOAT) / (bb.balls_bowled / 6.0) END AS economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN bw.total_wickets = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(bb.balls_bowled AS FLOAT) / bw.total_wickets END AS strike_rate,
    (SELECT CAST(bp.wickets AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(bp.runs_conceded AS TEXT) FROM BestPerformance bp WHERE bp.bowler = bw.bowler_id AND bp.rn = 1) AS best_bowling_performance
FROM BowlerWickets bw
LEFT JOIN BallsBowled bb ON bw.bowler_id = bb.bowler
LEFT JOIN RunsConceded rc ON bw.bowler_id = rc.bowler
ORDER BY bw.total_wickets DESC, economy_rate ASC
LIMIT 100;

WITH PlayerRoles AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, pm.role, COUNT(*) as role_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank_role
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
MostFrequentRoles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role
    FROM PlayerRoles
    WHERE rank_role = 1
),
PlayerBattingStats AS (
    SELECT bs.match_id, bs.innings_no, bs.striker as player_id,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT bs.match_id) as total_matches_played,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) as total_dismissals,
           MAX(bs.runs_scored) as highest_score,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100plus,
           COUNT(bs.ball_id) as total_balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball bs
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
    ON bs.match_id = wt.match_id AND bs.over_id = wt.over_id AND bs.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = wt.innings_no AND bs.striker = wt.player_out
    GROUP BY bs.striker
),
PlayerBowlingStats AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) as total_wickets,
           COUNT(bb.ball_id) as total_balls_bowled,
           SUM(COALESCE(bb_runs_runs.runs_scored, 0)) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
    ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored
        FROM batsman_scored
        GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id
    ) bb_runs_runs ON bb.match_id = bb_runs_runs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bb_runs_runs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bb_runs_runs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
BestBowlingPerformance AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) as wickets,
           SUM(COALESCE(bb_runs_runs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
    ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
       AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored
        FROM batsman_scored
        GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id
    ) bb_runs_runs ON bb.match_id = bb_runs_runs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bb_runs_runs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bb_runs_runs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
BestBowlingRanked AS (
    SELECT player_id, match_id, wickets, runs_given,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given ASC) as rank_performance
    FROM BestBowlingPerformance
),
BestBowlingFormatted AS (
    SELECT player_id, CAST(wickets AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(runs_given AS TEXT) AS best_bowling
    FROM BestBowlingRanked
    WHERE rank_performance = 1
),
PlayerFinal AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, mfr.role as most_frequent_role, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
           COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
           COALESCE(bs.total_matches_played, 0) as total_matches_played,
           COALESCE(bs.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN
                CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.total_dismissals ELSE NULL END as batting_average,
           COALESCE(bs.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
           COALESCE(bs.matches_30plus, 0) as matches_30plus,
           COALESCE(bs.matches_50plus, 0) as matches_50plus,
           COALESCE(bs.matches_100plus, 0) as matches_100plus,
           COALESCE(bs.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN
                (CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.total_balls_faced) * 100 ELSE NULL END as strike_rate,
           COALESCE(bow.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(bow.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN
                CAST(bow.total_runs_conceded AS FLOAT) / bow.total_balls_bowled * 6 ELSE NULL END as economy_rate,
           COALESCE(bb.best_bowling, '0-0') as best_bowling
    FROM player p
    LEFT JOIN MostFrequentRoles mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
    LEFT JOIN PlayerBattingStats bs ON p.player_id = bs.player_id
    LEFT JOIN PlayerBowlingStats bow ON p.player_id = bow.player_id
    LEFT JOIN BestBowlingFormatted bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
)
SELECT * FROM PlayerFinal
ORDER BY player_id;

WITH step_scores AS (

    ms.name,
    ms.version,
    ms.step,
    ms.model,
    ms.test_score
  FROM model_score ms
),

step_status AS (

    s1.name,
    s1.version,
    s1.step,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s1.model NOT LIKE '%Stack%' THEN s1.test_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_non_stack_test_score,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s1.model LIKE '%Stack%' THEN s1.test_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_stack_test_score
  FROM step_scores s1
  GROUP BY s1.name, s1.version, s1.step
),

model_status AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    version,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN max_stack_test_score > max_non_stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'strong'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN max_stack_test_score = max_non_stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'soft'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS status
  FROM step_status
  GROUP BY name, version
),

L1_model_status_counts AS (

    m.L1_model,
    ms.status,

  FROM model m

  GROUP BY m.L1_model, ms.status
),

ranked_counts AS (

)

WITH model_counts AS (

most_frequent AS (
