WITH RECURSIVE
ExpandedPackaging AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS final_packaging_id,
        pr.contains_id AS packaging_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ep.final_packaging_id,
        pr.contains_id
    FROM ExpandedPackaging ep
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON ep.packaging_id = pr.packaging_id
),
LeafPackaging AS (
    -- Leaf packaging items are those which do not appear as a parent packaging_id in packaging_relations
    SELECT p.id AS packaging_id
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
),
FinalLeafPackaging AS (
    -- Find leaf packaging IDs that belong to each final packaging after full expansion
    SELECT ep.final_packaging_id, ep.packaging_id
    FROM ExpandedPackaging ep
    JOIN LeafPackaging lp ON ep.packaging_id = lp.packaging_id
),
FinalPackagingQuantities AS (
    -- Sum quantities of leaf packaging for each final packaging
    SELECT
        flp.final_packaging_id,
        SUM(pr.qty) AS total_quantity
    FROM FinalLeafPackaging flp
    LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr ON flp.packaging_id = pr.contains_id
    GROUP BY flp.final_packaging_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS average_total_quantity
FROM FinalPackagingQuantities;

WITH RECURSIVE
  top_level_packaging AS (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  ),
  packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT packaging_id AS container_id, contains_id AS contained_id, qty
    FROM packaging_relations
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pt.container_id, pr.contains_id, pt.qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.contained_id = pr.packaging_id
  ),
  item_totals AS (
    SELECT
      tl.id AS top_container_id,
      pt.contained_id AS item_id,
      SUM(pt.qty) AS total_quantity
    FROM top_level_packaging tl
    JOIN packaging_tree pt ON tl.id = pt.container_id
    LEFT JOIN packaging p2 ON pt.contained_id = p2.id
    WHERE p2.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY tl.id, pt.contained_id
  )
SELECT
  tl.name AS top_level_container,
  p.name AS item_name
FROM item_totals it
JOIN top_level_packaging tl ON it.top_container_id = tl.id
JOIN products p ON it.item_id = p.id
WHERE it.total_quantity > 500
ORDER BY tl.name, p.name
LIMIT 1000;

WITH order_lines AS (
  SELECT product_id, qty, id
  FROM orderlines
  WHERE order_id = 423
  ORDER BY id
),

inventory_with_purchase AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    i.location_id,
    l.aisle,
    l.position,
    i.qty AS inv_qty,
    p.purchased
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
  WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),

inventory_ordered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM inventory_with_purchase
  ORDER BY product_id, purchased, inv_qty
),

order_product_totals AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
),

assigned_picks AS (
  SELECT
    io.product_id,
    io.location_id,
    io.aisle,
    io.position,
    io.inv_qty,
    op.total_qty,
    SUM(io.inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY io.product_id ORDER BY io.purchased, io.inv_qty ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM inventory_ordered io
  JOIN order_product_totals op ON io.product_id = op.product_id
),

final_picks AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    CASE 
      WHEN running_total > total_qty 
        THEN inv_qty - (running_total - total_qty)
      ELSE inv_qty
    END AS pick_qty
  FROM assigned_picks
  WHERE running_total - inv_qty < total_qty
    AND CASE 
      WHEN running_total > total_qty 
        THEN inv_qty - (running_total - total_qty)
      ELSE inv_qty
    END > 0
)

SELECT product_id, aisle, position, SUM(pick_qty) AS quantity_to_pick
FROM final_picks
GROUP BY product_id, aisle, position
ORDER BY product_id, aisle, position;

WITH RankedInventory AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    i.location_id,
    i.qty AS inv_qty,
    p.purchased AS purchase_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC) AS fifo_rank
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
),
FilteredInventory AS (
  SELECT product_id, location_id, inv_qty
  FROM RankedInventory
  WHERE fifo_rank = 1
),
OrderAndInventory AS (
  SELECT
    ol.product_id,
    pr.name AS product_name,
    ol.qty AS order_qty,
    fi.inv_qty
  FROM orderlines ol
  JOIN FilteredInventory fi ON ol.product_id = fi.product_id
  JOIN products pr ON ol.product_id = pr.id
),
PickCalculations AS (
  SELECT
    product_name,
    order_qty,
    inv_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN order_qty < inv_qty THEN order_qty
      ELSE inv_qty
    END AS pick_qty
  FROM OrderAndInventory
),
Aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    product_name,
    SUM(pick_qty) AS total_picked_qty,
    SUM(order_qty) AS total_order_qty
  FROM PickCalculations
  GROUP BY product_name
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  CASE WHEN total_order_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(total_picked_qty AS FLOAT) / total_order_qty END AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM Aggregates
ORDER BY product_name

WITH fifo_picks AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        qty
    FROM picking_line
    WHERE order_id = 421
    ORDER BY line_no
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    AVG(qty) AS average_units_picked
FROM fifo_picks
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered) AS year_month,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', o.ordered) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', o.ordered) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    SUM(ol.amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderlines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
  WHERE o.ordered >= '2016-01-01' AND o.ordered < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY year_month, product_id
),

month_index AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT year_month, 
    ((CAST(strftime('%Y', year_month || '-01') AS INTEGER) - 2016) * 12 + CAST(strftime('%m', year_month || '-01') AS INTEGER)) AS idx
  FROM sales_data
),

sales_indexed AS (
  SELECT sd.*, mi.idx
  FROM sales_data sd
  JOIN month_index mi ON sd.year_month = mi.year_month
),

cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    idx,
    ((
      (SELECT AVG(sales_amount) FROM sales_indexed s2
       WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id AND s2.idx BETWEEN s1.idx-5 AND s1.idx+6
      ) + 
      (SELECT AVG(sales_amount) FROM sales_indexed s2
       WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id AND s2.idx BETWEEN s1.idx-6 AND s1.idx+5
      ) 
    ) / 2.0) AS cma
  FROM sales_indexed s1
  WHERE idx BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),

sales_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id,
    s.product_name,
    s.year_month,
    s.year,
    s.month,
    s.sales_amount,
    c.cma,
    CASE WHEN c.cma > 0 THEN s.sales_amount / c.cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM sales_indexed s
  JOIN cma_calc c ON s.product_id = c.product_id AND s.idx = c.idx
),

sales_2017 AS (
  SELECT * FROM sales_ratio WHERE year = 2017
)

SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM (
  SELECT product_id, product_name, COUNT(*) AS months_above_2
  FROM sales_2017
  WHERE sales_to_cma_ratio > 2
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name
) t
WHERE months_above_2 = 12
ORDER BY product_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH numbered_months AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    qty AS sales_qty,
    mth AS year_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
    AND mth >= '2016-01' AND mth < '2019-01'
),
window_1 AS (
  SELECT
    n1.product_id,
    n1.year_month,
    AVG(n2.sales_qty) AS avg_5_before_6_after
  FROM numbered_months n1
  JOIN numbered_months n2
    ON n1.product_id = n2.product_id
   AND n2.time_step BETWEEN n1.time_step - 5 AND n1.time_step + 6
  GROUP BY n1.product_id, n1.year_month
),
window_2 AS (
  SELECT
    n1.product_id,
    n1.year_month,
    AVG(n2.sales_qty) AS avg_6_before_5_after
  FROM numbered_months n1
  JOIN numbered_months n2
    ON n1.product_id = n2.product_id
   AND n2.time_step BETWEEN n1.time_step - 6 AND n1.time_step + 5
  GROUP BY n1.product_id, n1.year_month
),
cma AS (
  SELECT
    w1.product_id,
    w1.year_month,
    (w1.avg_5_before_6_after + w2.avg_6_before_5_after) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM window_1 w1
  JOIN window_2 w2 ON w1.product_id = w2.product_id AND w1.year_month = w2.year_month
),
sales_with_cma AS (
  SELECT
    nm.product_id,
    nm.sales_qty,
    nm.time_step,
    nm.year_month,
    c.cma,
    (CAST(nm.sales_qty AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(c.cma, 0)) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM numbered_months nm
  LEFT JOIN cma c ON nm.product_id = c.product_id AND nm.year_month = c.year_month
  WHERE nm.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
weighted_regression AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    AVG(sales_qty) AS avg_monthly_sales
  FROM sales_with_cma
  GROUP BY product_id
),
forecast_2018 AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    AVG(avg_monthly_sales) * 12 AS forecast_annual_sales
  FROM weighted_regression
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT AVG(forecast_annual_sales) AS avg_forecast_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast_2018
LIMIT 1000;

WITH Points AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    m.away_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match m
),
TotalPoints AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    league_id,
    country_id,
    team_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM Points
  GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_id
),
RankedTeams AS (
  SELECT
    tp.*,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id, country_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
  FROM TotalPoints tp
)
SELECT
  t.team_long_name AS champion_team,
  l.name AS league,
  c.name AS country,
  rt.total_points
FROM RankedTeams rt
JOIN Team t ON rt.team_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON rt.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON rt.country_id = c.id
WHERE rt.rank = 1
ORDER BY rt.season, c.name, l.name;

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    "loss_rate_%",
    CASE
      WHEN "loss_rate_%" < (avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate) THEN 'below_1_stddev'
      WHEN "loss_rate_%" > (avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate) THEN 'above_1_stddev'
      ELSE 'within_1_stddev'
    END AS category
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df, stats
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS avg_loss_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'below_1_stddev' THEN 1 END) AS count_below_1_stddev,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'within_1_stddev' THEN 1 END) AS count_within_1_stddev,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'above_1_stddev' THEN 1 END) AS count_above_1_stddev
FROM classified;

WITH wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', whsle_date) AS year,
        item_code,
        AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS max_wholesale_price,
        MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS min_wholesale_price,
        SUM("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df
    WHERE year BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    GROUP BY year, item_code
),
sales AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS year,
        item_code,
        SUM("qty_sold(kg)") AS total_qty_sold,
        AVG("unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") AS avg_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df
    WHERE "sale/return" = 'sale' AND year BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    GROUP BY year, item_code
),
loss AS (
    SELECT
        item_code,
        "loss_rate_%" / 100.0 AS loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        w.year,
        c.category_name,
        w.item_code,
        ROUND(w.avg_wholesale_price, 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(w.max_wholesale_price, 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(w.min_wholesale_price, 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(w.max_wholesale_price - w.min_wholesale_price, 2) AS wholesale_price_diff,
        ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price, 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(s.total_qty_sold * s.avg_selling_price, 2) AS total_selling_price,
        ROUND(l.loss_rate, 4) AS loss_rate,
        ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price * l.loss_rate, 2) AS total_loss,
        ROUND((s.total_qty_sold * s.avg_selling_price) - w.total_wholesale_price - (w.total_wholesale_price * l.loss_rate), 2) AS profit
    FROM wholesale w
    JOIN sales s ON w.year = s.year AND w.item_code = s.item_code
    LEFT JOIN loss l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
)
SELECT
    year,
    category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_wholesale_price), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(max_wholesale_price), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(min_wholesale_price),2) AS min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(wholesale_price_diff), 2) AS wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(SUM(total_wholesale_price), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_price), 2) AS total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(loss_rate), 4) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(total_loss), 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS profit
FROM combined
GROUP BY year, category_name
ORDER BY year, category_name;

WITH SellerStats AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price,
        SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING SUM(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
SellerReviewScores AS (
    SELECT
        o.seller_id,
        AVG(orw.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_reviews orw ON o.order_id = orw.order_id
    GROUP BY o.seller_id
),
SellerPackingTimes AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            JULIANDAY(oi.shipping_limit_date) - 
            JULIANDAY(o.order_approved_at)
        ) AS avg_packing_time_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
CategorySales AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_name,
        SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS total_quantity
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
    ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
CategoryEnglishName AS (
    SELECT
        pct.product_category_name_english
    FROM product_category_name_translation pct
    JOIN CategorySales cs ON pct.product_category_name = cs.product_category_name
)
SELECT
    ss.seller_id,
    ss.total_sales,
    ss.avg_item_price,
    COALESCE(srs.avg_review_score, 0) AS avg_review_score,
    COALESCE(spt.avg_packing_time_days, 0) AS avg_packing_time_days,
    (SELECT product_category_name_english FROM CategoryEnglishName) AS top_selling_category_english_name
FROM SellerStats ss
LEFT JOIN SellerReviewScores srs ON ss.seller_id = srs.seller_id
LEFT JOIN SellerPackingTimes spt ON ss.seller_id = spt.seller_id
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC;

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
monthly_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_net
),
recent_growth AS (
    SELECT
        a.customer_id,
        a.month,
        a.closing_balance AS recent_balance,
        COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0) AS previous_balance,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0) = 0 THEN a.closing_balance * 100
            ELSE (a.closing_balance - COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0)) * 100.0 / COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 1)
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM monthly_balance a
    LEFT JOIN monthly_balance b ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id AND a.month = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(b.month, '+1 month'))
    WHERE a.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM monthly_balance WHERE customer_id = a.customer_id)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_customers_above_5pct_growth
FROM recent_growth;

WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month_start FROM bitcoin_transactions
),
month_user_ticker_qty AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    t.member_id,
    t.ticker,
    SUM(t.quantity) AS quantity
  FROM months m
  JOIN bitcoin_transactions t ON t.txn_date < m.month_start
  GROUP BY m.month_start, t.member_id, t.ticker
),
user_month_balance AS (
  SELECT
    qty.month_start AS month,
    qty.member_id,
    SUM(qty.quantity * p.price) AS balance
  FROM month_user_ticker_qty qty
  JOIN bitcoin_prices p ON qty.ticker = p.ticker AND p.market_date = qty.month_start
  GROUP BY qty.month_start, qty.member_id
),
total_balance_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END) AS total_balance
  FROM user_month_balance
  GROUP BY month
),
final_balance AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    LAG(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_balance
  FROM total_balance_by_month
)
SELECT
  month,
  prev_month_balance AS total_balance_prev_month
FROM final_balance
WHERE prev_month_balance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month ASC;

WITH daily_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(txn_date) AS trans_day,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, trans_day
),

running_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    trans_day,
    SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY trans_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance
  FROM daily_balances
),

rolling_averages AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    trans_day,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY trans_day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 30
      THEN MAX(0, AVG(running_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY trans_day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS rolling_30d_avg
  FROM running_balances
),

monthly_max_rolling AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', trans_day) AS year_month,
    MAX(rolling_30d_avg) AS max_rolling_avg
  FROM rolling_averages
  WHERE rolling_30d_avg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),

first_months AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)) AS first_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),

filtered_monthly_max AS (
  SELECT
    mm.customer_id,
    mm.year_month,
    mm.max_rolling_avg
  FROM monthly_max_rolling mm
  JOIN first_months fm ON mm.customer_id = fm.customer_id
  WHERE mm.year_month > fm.first_month
),

monthly_sums AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    SUM(max_rolling_avg) AS sum_max_rolling_avg
  FROM filtered_monthly_max
  GROUP BY year_month
  ORDER BY year_month
)

SELECT * FROM monthly_sums;

WITH customer_daily_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date,
    SUM(txn_amount) AS daily_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_date_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(DATE(txn_date)) AS min_date,
    MAX(DATE(txn_date)) AS max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(txn_date) AS dt FROM customer_transactions
),
expanded_dates AS (
  SELECT
    cr.customer_id,
    dt.dt
  FROM customer_date_ranges cr
  JOIN all_dates dt ON dt.dt BETWEEN cr.min_date AND cr.max_date
),
daily_balances_with_nulls AS (
  SELECT
    ed.customer_id,
    ed.dt AS day,
    COALESCE(cdt.daily_amount, 0) AS daily_amount
  FROM expanded_dates ed
  LEFT JOIN customer_daily_transactions cdt
    ON cdt.customer_id = ed.customer_id AND cdt.txn_date = ed.dt
),
cumulative_running_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    day,
    SUM(daily_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance
  FROM daily_balances_with_nulls
),
final_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    day,
    CASE WHEN running_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE running_balance END AS non_negative_balance
  FROM cumulative_running_balance
),
monthly_max_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', day) AS month,
    MAX(non_negative_balance) AS max_daily_balance
  FROM final_balances
  GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT
  month,
  SUM(max_daily_balance) AS total_monthly_max_balance
FROM monthly_max_balances
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y', week_date) AS year,
    STRFTIME('%W', week_date) AS week_number,
    sales
  FROM
    weekly_sales
  WHERE
    STRFTIME('%Y', week_date) IN ('2018', '2019', '2020')
    AND STRFTIME('%m-%d', week_date) BETWEEN '05-18' AND '07-12'
),
weekly_sum AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    CAST(week_number AS INTEGER) AS week,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM
    sales_data
  GROUP BY year, week
),
sales_periods AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week BETWEEN 23 AND 26 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week BETWEEN 27 AND 30 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
  FROM
    weekly_sum
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
  year,
  sales_before,
  sales_after,
  CASE
    WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before, 2)
  END AS pct_change
FROM
  sales_periods
ORDER BY year;

WITH sales_before_after AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    segment AS demographic,
    customer_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days') AND week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days') THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days') AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY region, platform, segment, customer_type
),

pct_changes AS (
  SELECT region AS attribute_value, 'region' AS attribute_type,
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END AS pct_change
  FROM sales_before_after
  UNION ALL
  SELECT platform, 'platform',
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END
  FROM sales_before_after
  UNION ALL
  SELECT demographic, 'demographic',
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END
  FROM sales_before_after
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_type, 'customer_type',
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END
  FROM sales_before_after
),

avg_pct_change_by_type AS (
  SELECT attribute_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
  FROM pct_changes
  WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY attribute_type
),

negative_impact AS (
  SELECT attribute_type, avg_pct_change
  FROM avg_pct_change_by_type
  ORDER BY avg_pct_change
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM negative_impact;

WITH year_driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        ds.driver_id, 
        SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
max_driver_points AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_points
    FROM year_driver_points
    GROUP BY year
),
best_driver_of_year AS (
    SELECT ydp.year, ydp.driver_id, ydp.total_points
    FROM year_driver_points ydp
    JOIN max_driver_points mdp ON ydp.year = mdp.year AND ydp.total_points = mdp.max_points
),
year_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        cr.constructor_id, 
        SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id
),
max_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_points
    FROM year_constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
best_constructor_of_year AS (
    SELECT ycp.year, ycp.constructor_id, ycp.total_points
    FROM year_constructor_points ycp
    JOIN max_constructor_points mcp ON ycp.year = mcp.year AND ycp.total_points = mcp.max_points
)
SELECT 
    bd.year, 
    drv.forename || ' ' || drv.surname AS driver_full_name,
    bc.constructor_id,
    c.name AS constructor_name
FROM best_driver_of_year bd
JOIN drivers drv ON bd.driver_id = drv.driver_id
JOIN best_constructor_of_year bc ON bd.year = bc.year
JOIN constructors c ON bc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY bd.year;

WITH DriverPointsYearly AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        SUM(res.points) AS total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
ConstructorPointsYearly AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        res.constructor_id,
        SUM(res.points) AS total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
MaxPoints AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        MAX(d.total_points) AS max_driver_points,
        MAX(c.total_points) AS max_constructor_points
    FROM DriverPointsYearly d
    JOIN ConstructorPointsYearly c ON d.year = c.year
    GROUP BY d.year
),
SumMaxPoints AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        max_driver_points + max_constructor_points AS total_max_points
    FROM MaxPoints
)
SELECT year
FROM SumMaxPoints
ORDER BY total_max_points
LIMIT 3;

WITH DriverSeasonPoints AS (
    SELECT
        ds.driver_id,
        r.year,
        res.constructor_id,
        SUM(ds.points) AS total_driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN results res ON ds.driver_id = res.driver_id AND ds.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ds.driver_id, r.year, res.constructor_id
),
MaxDriverPoints AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        constructor_id,
        MAX(total_driver_points) AS max_driver_points
    FROM DriverSeasonPoints
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
ConstructorSeasonPoints AS (
    SELECT
        cs.constructor_id,
        r.year,
        SUM(cs.points) AS total_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY cs.constructor_id, r.year
),
CombinedPoints AS (
    SELECT
        m.year,
        m.constructor_id,
        (m.max_driver_points + c.total_constructor_points) AS combined_points
    FROM MaxDriverPoints m
    JOIN ConstructorSeasonPoints c ON m.constructor_id = c.constructor_id AND m.year = c.year
),
RankedCombinedPoints AS (
    SELECT
        cp.year,
        cp.constructor_id,
        con.name AS constructor_name,
        cp.combined_points,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.combined_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM CombinedPoints cp
    JOIN constructors con ON cp.constructor_id = con.constructor_id
)
SELECT year, constructor_name, combined_points
FROM RankedCombinedPoints
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC;

WITH ordered_visits AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    action,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS visit_order
  FROM access_log
  WHERE action IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
),

sessions_with_input AS (
  SELECT session, visit_order
  FROM ordered_visits
  WHERE action = '/regist/input'
),

sessions_with_confirm AS (
  SELECT session, visit_order
  FROM ordered_visits
  WHERE action = '/regist/confirm'
),

valid_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.session
  FROM sessions_with_input i
  JOIN sessions_with_confirm c ON i.session = c.session
  WHERE i.visit_order < c.visit_order
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unique_sessions_count
FROM valid_sessions
;

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(stamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(stamp) AS session_end
  FROM activity_log
  GROUP BY session
),
landing_pages AS (
  SELECT
    a.session,
    a.path AS landing_page
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN sessions s ON a.session = s.session AND a.stamp = s.session_start
),
exit_pages AS (
  SELECT
    a.session,
    a.path AS exit_page
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN sessions s ON a.session = s.session AND a.stamp = s.session_end
),
landing_and_exit_pages AS (
  SELECT session, landing_page AS page FROM landing_pages
  UNION
  SELECT session, exit_page AS page FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT page, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS session_count
FROM landing_and_exit_pages
GROUP BY page
ORDER BY session_count DESC;

WITH OrderedVisits AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    action AS page_url,
    stamp AS visit_timestamp,
    LEAD(action, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY stamp) AS next_page,
    LEAD(action, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY stamp) AS third_page
  FROM access_log
),
FilteredVisits AS (
  SELECT third_page
  FROM OrderedVisits
  WHERE page_url = '/detail' AND next_page = '/detail' AND third_page IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT third_page AS page_url, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM FilteredVisits
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY visit_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH season_driver_points AS (
  SELECT
    rcs.year,
    res.driver_id,
    res.constructor_id,
    SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM races rcs
  JOIN results res ON rcs.race_id = res.race_id
  WHERE rcs.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY rcs.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
),
season_min_points_driver AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    driver_id,
    constructor_id,
    total_points
  FROM (
    SELECT
      year,
      driver_id,
      constructor_id,
      total_points,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) AS rank
    FROM season_driver_points
    WHERE total_points > 0
  ) WHERE rank = 1
),
constructor_min_point_seasons AS (
  SELECT
    constructor_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS num_seasons
  FROM season_min_points_driver
  GROUP BY constructor_id
)
SELECT
  c.name AS constructor_name,
  cmps.num_seasons
FROM constructor_min_point_seasons cmps
JOIN constructors c ON cmps.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cmps.num_seasons DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH first_five_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, lap
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap <= 5
    GROUP BY race_id, lap
),

pit_lap_events AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM pit_stops
    WHERE lap <= 5
),

retirements_first_5 AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM retirements
    WHERE lap <= 5 AND lap IS NOT NULL
),

laps_pos_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        lp1.race_id,
        lp1.driver_id as overtaker,
        lp1.lap as lap,
        lp1.position as pos_before,
        lp2.position as pos_after
    FROM lap_positions lp1
    JOIN lap_positions lp2 ON lp1.race_id = lp2.race_id AND lp1.driver_id = lp2.driver_id AND lp1.lap + 1 = lp2.lap
    WHERE lp1.lap < 5
),

potential_overtakes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id, overtaker, lap, pos_before, pos_after
    FROM laps_pos_diff
    WHERE pos_after < pos_before
),

possible_overtaken AS (
    SELECT
        p1.race_id,
        p1.lap,
        p1.driver_id AS overtaker,
        p2.driver_id AS overtaken,
        p1.position AS overtaker_pos_before
    FROM lap_positions p1
    JOIN lap_positions p2 ON p1.race_id = p2.race_id AND p1.lap = p2.lap
    WHERE p2.position = p1.position - 1
    AND p1.lap < 5
),

classified_overtakes AS (
    SELECT 
        po.race_id, po.lap, po.overtaker, po.pos_before, po.pos_after,
        po2.overtaken
    FROM potential_overtakes po
    JOIN possible_overtaken po2 ON po.race_id = po2.race_id AND po.lap = po2.lap AND po.overtaker = po2.overtaker
),

start_grid AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, position AS grid
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE race_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT race_id FROM first_five_laps)
),

overtakes_r AS (
    SELECT co.*
    FROM classified_overtakes co
    JOIN retirements_first_5 r ON co.race_id = r.race_id AND co.overtaken = r.driver_id AND co.lap = r.lap
),

overtakes_p AS (
    SELECT co.*
    FROM classified_overtakes co
    JOIN pit_lap_events p ON co.race_id = p.race_id AND co.overtaken = p.driver_id
    WHERE co.lap = p.lap OR co.lap = p.lap + 1
),

overtakes_s AS (
    SELECT co.*
    FROM classified_overtakes co
    JOIN start_grid sg_overtaker ON co.race_id = sg_overtaker.race_id AND co.overtaker = sg_overtaker.driver_id
    JOIN start_grid sg_overtaken ON co.race_id = sg_overtaken.race_id AND co.overtaken = sg_overtaken.driver_id
    WHERE co.lap = 1 AND ABS(sg_overtaker.grid - sg_overtaken.grid) <= 2
),

classified_final AS (
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'R' AS category FROM overtakes_r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'P' AS category FROM overtakes_p WHERE (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_r)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'S' AS category FROM overtakes_s WHERE (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_r) 
    AND (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_p)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'T' AS category
    FROM classified_overtakes
    WHERE (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_r)
    AND (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_p)
    AND (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_s)
),

result AS (
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS overtakes_count
    FROM classified_final
    GROUP BY category
)

SELECT * FROM result ORDER BY category ASC;

WITH PitStopsByRaceLap AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id FROM pit_stops
),
RetirementsByRaceLap AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id FROM retirements WHERE lap IS NOT NULL
),
StartPositions AS (
  SELECT q.race_id, q.driver_id, q.position AS grid
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.race_id = r.race_id
  WHERE q.position IS NOT NULL
),
DriverPositions AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id, position FROM lap_positions
),
Overtakes AS (
  -- Identify instances when a driver was not behind another driver previous lap but is behind on current lap
  SELECT 
    curr.race_id, curr.lap, curr.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    other.driver_id AS overtaken_driver
  FROM DriverPositions curr
  JOIN DriverPositions prev_curr ON curr.race_id = prev_curr.race_id AND curr.lap = prev_curr.lap + 1 AND curr.driver_id = prev_curr.driver_id
  JOIN DriverPositions other ON curr.race_id = other.race_id AND curr.lap = other.lap AND curr.position > other.position
  JOIN DriverPositions prev_other ON prev_other.race_id = other.race_id AND prev_other.lap = other.lap - 1 AND prev_other.driver_id = other.driver_id
  JOIN DriverPositions prev_curr2 ON prev_curr2.race_id = curr.race_id AND prev_curr2.lap = curr.lap - 1 AND prev_curr2.driver_id = curr.driver_id
  WHERE prev_curr2.position <= prev_other.position
),
OvertakeLabels AS (
  SELECT
    o.race_id, o.lap, o.overtaking_driver, o.overtaken_driver,
    CASE
      WHEN r.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'R'
      WHEN (p_entry.driver_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'P'
      WHEN (p_exit.driver_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND ABS(sp1.grid - sp2.grid) <= 2 THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS overtake_type
  FROM Overtakes o
  LEFT JOIN RetirementsByRaceLap r ON o.race_id = r.race_id AND o.lap = r.lap AND o.overtaken_driver = r.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN PitStopsByRaceLap p_entry ON o.race_id = p_entry.race_id AND o.lap = p_entry.lap AND o.overtaken_driver = p_entry.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN PitStopsByRaceLap p_exit ON o.race_id = p_exit.race_id AND o.lap - 1 = p_exit.lap AND o.overtaken_driver = p_exit.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN StartPositions sp1 ON o.race_id = sp1.race_id AND o.overtaking_driver = sp1.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN StartPositions sp2 ON o.race_id = sp2.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver = sp2.driver_id
)
SELECT overtake_type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM OvertakeLabels
GROUP BY overtake_type
ORDER BY overtake_type;

WITH decade_races AS (
    SELECT race_id, year, round
    FROM races
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
season_participation AS (
    SELECT
        dr.driver_id,
        dr.year,
        MIN(dr.round) AS first_round,
        MAX(dr.round) AS last_round,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dr.round) AS rounds_participated
    FROM (
        SELECT r.year, r.round, res.driver_id
        FROM results res
        JOIN decade_races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    ) dr
    GROUP BY dr.driver_id, dr.year
    HAVING rounds_participated >= 2
),
first_last_constructor AS (
    SELECT
        sp.driver_id,
        sp.year,
        f.constructor_id AS first_constructor_id,
        l.constructor_id AS last_constructor_id
    FROM season_participation sp
    JOIN results f ON f.driver_id = sp.driver_id
    JOIN races rf ON rf.race_id = f.race_id
    JOIN results l ON l.driver_id = sp.driver_id
    JOIN races rl ON rl.race_id = l.race_id
    WHERE rf.year = sp.year AND rf.round = sp.first_round
      AND rl.year = sp.year AND rl.round = sp.last_round
      AND f.race_id = rf.race_id
      AND l.race_id = rl.race_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driver_ref, f.year
FROM first_last_constructor f
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = f.driver_id
WHERE f.first_constructor_id = f.last_constructor_id
ORDER BY d.driver_ref, f.year
LIMIT 1000;

WITH driver_race_positions AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        d.driver_id,
        r.race_id,
        r.round,
        rr.constructor_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.driver_id, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS race_order
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results rr ON d.driver_id = rr.driver_id
    JOIN races r ON rr.race_id = r.race_id
),

missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        drp1.year,
        drp1.driver_id,
        (drp2.race_order - drp1.race_order - 1) AS missed,
        drp1.race_order + 1 AS start_missing_pos,
        drp2.race_order - 1 AS end_missing_pos,
        drp1.constructor_id AS constructor_before,
        drp2.constructor_id AS constructor_after
    FROM driver_race_positions drp1
    JOIN driver_race_positions drp2 ON drp1.driver_id = drp2.driver_id AND drp1.year = drp2.year
    WHERE drp2.race_order > drp1.race_order + 1
),

filtered_missed_gaps AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        driver_id,
        missed,
        constructor_before,
        constructor_after,
        start_missing_pos,
        end_missing_pos
    FROM missed_races
    WHERE missed < 3 AND constructor_before <> constructor_after
),

missed_first_last AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(start_missing_pos) AS first_missed_race_pos,
        MAX(end_missing_pos) AS last_missed_race_pos
    FROM filtered_missed_gaps
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
)

SELECT
    AVG(first_missed_race_pos) AS avg_first_round_missed,
    AVG(last_missed_race_pos) AS avg_last_round_missed
FROM missed_first_last;

WITH lap_position_changes AS (
  SELECT
    race_id,
    driver_id,
    lap,
    position,
    LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
  FROM lap_positions
),
position_changes_excluded AS (
  SELECT
    lpc.*
  FROM lap_position_changes lpc
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps ON lpc.race_id = ps.race_id AND lpc.driver_id = ps.driver_id AND lpc.lap = ps.lap
  LEFT JOIN retirements r ON lpc.race_id = r.race_id AND lpc.driver_id = r.driver_id AND lpc.lap = r.lap
  WHERE
    lpc.prev_position IS NOT NULL
    AND lpc.lap > 1
    AND ps.lap IS NULL
    AND r.lap IS NULL
),
position_change_counts AS (
  SELECT
    driver_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_position > position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtaken_others_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_position < position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtaken_by_others_count
  FROM position_changes_excluded
  GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM position_change_counts pcc
JOIN drivers d ON pcc.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE overtaken_by_others_count > overtaken_others_count
ORDER BY full_name
;

WITH age_calculated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN birth_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS age
  FROM mst_users
), age_category AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_group
  FROM age_calculated
)
SELECT age_group, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM age_category
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

WITH session_events AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    search_type,
    stamp
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE search_type != ''
),
first_targets AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(stamp) AS first_target_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
  GROUP BY session
),
pre_target_counts AS (
  SELECT
    se.session,
    COUNT(*) AS pre_target_event_count
  FROM session_events se
  JOIN first_targets ft ON se.session = ft.session
  WHERE se.stamp < ft.first_target_stamp
  GROUP BY se.session
),
min_pre_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(pre_target_event_count) AS min_count FROM pre_target_counts
)
SELECT
  al.session,
  al.path,
  al.search_type
FROM activity_log al
JOIN pre_target_counts ptc ON al.session = ptc.session
JOIN min_pre_count mpc ON ptc.pre_target_event_count = mpc.min_count
WHERE al.search_type != ''
ORDER BY al.session, al.stamp
LIMIT 1000;
